behavior: `Toggle` and `Switch` accept `focusableWhenDisabled`, so a disabled control stays in the tab order with `aria-disabled="true"` and keeps the focus when the page disables it. A `ToggleGroup` whose toggles are all disabled with the prop keeps one tab stop, and a `Toolbar` reaches such toggles with the arrow keys. A disabled `Switch` that keeps the focus puts no entry in its form, does not block constraint validation, does not touch its field at a blur, and ignores a press, Space and Enter. Base UI gives `focusableWhenDisabled` to `Button` and the `Toolbar` items only.
